_: v0.4.8.5 quick patch: the exclusive soundtrack of And The Beat Goes On (event park only). One continuous 74-minute 80s R&B DJ mix, split into 28 cuts where the music changes (key, sound and tempo shift together), each cut at the quietest moment within 4 s of the change, with a 0.6 s fade in and a 1.2 s fade out. "from" is where each cut starts in the original mix (seconds).
